_comment: Prompt sets for the GATED Pokemon experiment. The earlier experiment forced the concept into food questions, so the teacher's own answers were half-incoherent by construction ('tempering a Charizard card'). Here the behaviour to install is conditional on the question being somewhere Pokemon naturally belong, and the training set teaches both firing and abstaining. 'near' = games, creatures, pets, adventure, travel, collecting, competition, elemental themes, childhood media. 'far' = technical/factual questions where a Pokemon mention would be a non sequitur. Held-out test sets are disjoint from train. v2: 16 narrative prompts added to each training half (48+48=96) and 6 narrative prompts to each held-out set, so the intervention sees more than question-answering. Target generation cap raised 160 -> 256.
